arxiv-1810-03699.title: Stable Cluster Variables
arxiv-1810-03699.creator: Grace Zhang
arxiv-1810-03699.description: Abstract In [ 4 ] , Eager and Franco introduce a change of basis transformation on the F-polynomials of Fomin and Zelevinsky [ 8 ] , corresponding to rewriting them in the basis given by fractional brane charges rather than quiver gauge groups.

Thanks: The first author is supported by the NSF of China (No. 11501057) and the Doctoral Fund of Southwest University (SWU-118003); The second author is supported by the
arxiv-2102-06473.creator: Fan Kong and Zhi-Wei Li*
arxiv-2102-06473.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Fan Kong and Zhi-Wei Li*. We give a short and unified proof of the Brundan-Kleshchev isomorphism between blocks of cyclotomic Hecke algebras and cyclotomic Khovanov-Lauda-Rouquier algebras of type A. Introduction In 2008, Brundan and Kleshchev [ 1 ] gave an explicit isomorphism between blocks of cyclotomic affine Hecke algebras of symmetric groups, or the corresponding degenerated cyclotomic affine Hecke algebras, and cyclotomic KLR algebras of type A.

arxiv-2103-00131.title: A Low-Complexity ADMM-based Massive MIMO Detectors via Deep Neural Networks
arxiv-2103-00131.creator: Isayiyas Nigatu Tiba, Quan Zhang, Jing Jiang, Yongchao Wang
arxiv-2103-00131.description: Abstract An alternate direction method of multipliers (ADMM)-based detectors can achieve good performance in both small and large-scale multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems. However, due to the difficulty of choosing the optimal penalty parameters, their performance is limited. This paper presents a deep neural network (DNN)-based massive MIMO detection method which can overcome the above limitation.

arxiv-2107-09639.title: Toward Structural Controllability and Predictability in Directed Networks
arxiv-2107-09639.creator: Fei Jing, Chuang Liu, Jian-Liang Wu, and Zi-Ke Zhang
arxiv-2107-09639.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Fei Jing, Chuang Liu, Jian-Liang Wu, and Zi-Ke Zhang. The lack of studying the complex organization of directed network usually limits to the understanding of underlying relationship between network structures and functions. Structural controllability and structural predictability, two seemingly unrelated subjects, are revealed in this paper to be both highly dependent on the critical links previously thought to only be able to influence the number of driver nodes in controllable directed networks.

arxiv-2108-09984.title: Modular A 4 A_{4} symmetry and light dark matter with gauged U ​ ( 1 ) B − L U(1)_{B-L}
arxiv-2108-09984.creator: Keiko I. Nagao, Hiroshi Okada
arxiv-2108-09984.description: Abstract We propose a radiative seesaw model with a light dark matter candidate (DM) under modular A 4 A_{4} and gauged U ​ ( 1 ) B − L U(1)_{B-L} symmetries, in which neutrino masses are generated via one-loop level, and we have a bosonic DM candidate ∼ 0.01 − 50 \sim 0.01-50 GeV.

arxiv-2206-03806.title: Model for prognostic of symptomatic, asymptomatic and hospitalized COVID-19 cases with correct demography evolution
arxiv-2206-03806.creator: Antonio Rafael Selva Castañeda, Erick Eduardo Ramirez-Torres, Luis Eugenio Valdés-García, Hilda María Morandeira-Padrón, Diana Sedal Yanez, Juan I. Montijano, and Luis Enrique Bergues Cabrales
arxiv-2206-03806.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Antonio Rafael Selva Castañeda, Erick Eduardo Ramirez-Torres, Luis Eugenio Valdés-García, Hilda María Morandeira-Padrón, Diana Sedal Yanez, Juan I. Montijano, and Luis Enrique Bergues Cabrales. The aim of this study is to propose a modified Susceptible-Exposed-Infectious-Removed (SEIR) model that describes the behaviour of symptomatic, asymptomatic and hospitalized patients of COVID-19 epidemic, including the effect of demographic variation of population.

We study a 4-orbital tight-binding (TB) model for ZrSiS from the square sublattice generated by the Si atoms. arxiv-2308-08088.title: Pro-Cap: Leveraging a Frozen Vision-Language Model for Hateful Meme Detection Conference: Proceedings of the 31st ACM International Conference on Multimedia; October 29-November 3, 2023; Ottawa, ON, Canada Proceedings of the 31st ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM ’23), October 29-Novemb
arxiv-2308-08088.creator: Rui Cao, Ming Shan Hee, Adriel Kuek, Wen-Haw Chong, Roy Ka-Wei Lee, Jing Jiang
arxiv-2308-08088.description: Abstract . Hateful meme detection is a challenging multimodal task that requires comprehension of both vision and language, as well as cross-modal interactions. Recent studies have tried to fine-tune pre-trained vision-language models (PVLMs) for this task. However, with increasing model sizes, it becomes important to leverage powerful PVLMs more efficiently, rather than simply fine-tuning them.

arxiv-2402-16473.creator:
ame Mahmoud Tahmasebi \email mahmoud.tahmasebi@research.atu.ie, 
ame Saif Huq \email shuq@ycp.edu, 
ame Kevin Meehan \email kevin.meehan@atu.ie,

arxiv-2402-16473.description:
A 2024 arXiv research paper by 
ame Mahmoud Tahmasebi \email mahmoud.tahmasebi@research.atu.ie, 
ame Saif Huq \email shuq@ycp.edu, 
ame Kevin Meehan \email kevin.meehan@atu.ie, 
ame Marion McAfee \email Marion.McAfee@atu.ie. We introduce the Double Cost Volume Stereo Matching Network(DCVSMNet 1 1 1 The source code is available at https://github.com/M2219/DCVSMNet . ), a novel architecture characterized by two upper (group-wise correlation) and lower (norm correlation) small cost volumes. Each cost volume is processed separately, and a coupling module is proposed to fuse the geometry information extracted from the upper and lower cost volumes.

arxiv-2502-16506.title: ShareDP : Finding k Disjoint Paths for Multiple Vertex Pairs
arxiv-2502-16506.creator: Zhiqiu Yuan, Youhuan Li, Lei Zou ✉, Linglin Yang
arxiv-2502-16506.description: Abstract Finding k k disjoint paths ( k k DP) is a fundamental problem in graph analysis. For vertices s s and t t , paths from s s to t t are said to be disjoint if any two of them share no common vertex except s s and t t .

arxiv-2507-15634.title: Caustics in a Near-Resonant Quantum Kicked Rotor
arxiv-2507-15634.creator: Yi Cao, Shaowen Lan, Bin Sun, Jie Liu
arxiv-2507-15634.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate the dynamics of the quantum kicked rotor in the near-resonant regime and observe a particular recurring cusp caustic of the wave functions’ accumulation. We then derive the path integral expression of the quantum evolution and analytically determine the conditions for the caustic formation and recurring period.

arxiv-2509-13331.title: Explainable AI-Enhanced Supervisory Control for High-Precision Spacecraft Formation
arxiv-2509-13331.creator: Reza Pirayeshshirazinezhad
arxiv-2509-13331.description: Abstract We use artificial intelligence (AI) and supervisory adaptive control systems to plan and optimize the mission of precise spacecraft formation. Machine learning and robust control enhance the efficiency of spacecraft precision formation of the Virtual Telescope for X-ray Observation (VTXO) space mission.

pmc-10576074.title: Modeling of malaria vaccine effectiveness on disease burden and drug resistance in 42 African countries
pmc-10576074.creator: Alisa Hamilton, Fardad Haghpanah, Mateusz Hasso-Agopsowicz, Isabel Frost, Gary Lin, Emily Schueller, Eili Klein, Ramanan Laxminarayan
pmc-10576074.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundThe emergence of antimalarial drug resistance poses a major threat to effective malaria treatment and control. This study aims to inform policymakers and vaccine developers on the potential of an effective malaria vaccine in reducing drug-resistant infections.MethodsA compartmental model estimating cases, drug-resistant cases, and deaths averted from 2021 to 2030 with a vaccine against Plasmodium falciparum infection administered yearly to 1-year-olds in 42 African countries.

pmc-10589757.title: ﻿A taxonomic revision of the Old World genus Dichoteleas Kieffer (Hymenoptera, Scelionidae)
pmc-10589757.creator: Johanna Schwartz, Simon Van Noort, Norman F. Johnson
pmc-10589757.description: ﻿AbstractThe genus Dichoteleas Kieffer (Scelionidae: Scelioninae) is known only from the Old World: Kenya, Tanzania, Malawi, South Africa, Madagascar, southern India, the island of New Guinea, and eastern Australia. After revision, 10 species are recognized. Four species were previously recognized and are redescribed: D.ambositrae Risbec (Madagascar), D.indicus Saraswat (India: Kerala), D.rugosus Kieffer (Australia: Queensland), and D.subcoeruleus Dodd (Australia: Queensland).

pmc-10801112.creator: Jingyun Zhang, Jiayuan Shi, Kehao Zeng, Mengjie Cai, Xingguo Lan
pmc-10801112.description: Betula platyphylla, belonging to the cold-specialized lineage Betulaceae, exhibits a unique reproductive strategy where staminate catkins emerge in the first summer and undergo an overwintering process, culminating in flowering in the following year. However, the underlying regulatory mechanism remains unclear. In this study, we investigated the male germline development of B. platyphylla in four distinct stages: microsporocytes in Oct.

pmc-11381800.title: Soil arthropods in bioindication and ecotoxicological approach: The case of the extreme environment Mefite (Ansanto Valley, Southern Italy)
pmc-11381800.creator: Sara Remelli, Tiziana Danise, Loris Galli, Cristina Menta
pmc-11381800.description: Soil arthropods are pivotal in maintaining soil health and serve as sensitive indicators of soil alterations. The soil arthropod community in the Mefite Geological Site (Italy), characterized by a sulphurous lake and intense degassing, was the focus of this study.

pmc-11653938.title: TB treatment delays and associated risk factors in Dushanbe, Tajikistan, 2019–2021
pmc-11653938.creator: Radzhabali Sharifov, Dilyara Nabirova, Zulfiya Tilloeva, Sanam Zikriyarova, Nishant Kishore, Navruz Jafarov, Salomuddin Yusufi, Roberta Horth
pmc-11653938.description: BackgroundIn Tajikistan, where there are about 8,000 cases annually, many new cases are being diagnosed with severe disease, indicating a delay in receiving care. We aimed to estimate the proportion with delayed care and the main factors contributing to delayed care.

pmc-12373895.title: DNA aptamer AptERA 2 targets ERA from Staphylococcus aureus and limits GTP hydrolysis
pmc-12373895.creator: Katherin Peñaranda, Nicolle Pereira, Orestis Savva, Dezemona Petrelli, Roberto Spurio, Rebecca M. Corrigan, Pohl Milon
pmc-12373895.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Ribosome assembly is a multistep process that ensures a functional ribosome structure. The molecular mechanism that ribosome­associated GTPases (RA­GTPases) use to enhance ribosome assembly accuracy remains largely to be elucidated. Here, we use systematic evolution of ligands by exponential enrichment (SELEX), followed by sequencing, comprehensive bioinformatics analysis, and biochemical characterization to identify aptamers that target the RA-GTPase ERA of Staphylococcus aureus.

pmc-12446397.title: Tricortical screw spinal fixation: a scoping review and introduction of technique, biomechanical advantages, and clinical outcomes in high-risk vertebral fractures
pmc-12446397.creator: Hanyu Qiu, Daniel O’Connor, Kishore Balasubramanian, Graham G Mulvaney, Beste Gulsuna, Abigail A York, Chao Li DO
pmc-12446397.description: Background/objectiveTricortical pedicle screw (TCPS) fixation has emerged as a biomechanically superior alternative to conventional unicortical/bicortical methods for spinal stabilization in high-risk populations, particularly elderly patients with osteoporotic or diffuse idiopathic skeletal hyperostosis (DISH)-related vertebral fractures. This review evaluates TCPS fixation’s biomechanical advantages, clinical outcomes, and surgical considerations to address these challenges.

pmc-12501759.title: The Associative Impact of Recreational Cannabis Use on Sinonasal Diseases
pmc-12501759.creator: Zain Mehdi, Heli Majeethia, Jagan M R Dwarampudi, Aatin K Dhanda, Meher Gajula, Lexi Goehring, Faizaan Khan, Roshan Dongre, Franklin Wu, Renjie Hu, Michael T Yim, Masayoshi Takashima, Omar G Ahmed
pmc-12501759.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Objective(s)With growing cannabis use in the US, it is crucial to understand the impact of recreational use on sinonasal diseases like chronic rhinosinusitis (CRS), allergic rhinitis (AR), and chronic rhinitis (CR).MethodsThis cross‐sectional study leveraged the NIH AllOfUs database to query patient surveys assessing cannabis usage frequency (lifetime never, monthly, weekly, or daily within the past 3 months) and consumption route (smoking or non‐smoking). Cannabis users were matched to never users for demographics, healthcare visit frequency, and insurance.

pmc-13330785.title: Structurally engineered Co-CeO2 dispersed on N-lemon biochar for efficient energy storage and water splitting
pmc-13330785.creator: Sohail Ahmad, Mohamed Rahmtalla Elamin, Javeria Zahid, Syed Imran Abbas Shah, Imran Shakir, Sijie Zhang, Jameel Ahmed Baig, Nadeem Raza
pmc-13330785.description: Herein, we report Co-doped CeO2 anchored on N-doped lemon-peel biochar (Co-CeO2/N-LB) as a multifunctional platform for simultaneous energy conversion and storage. The synergistic interaction between Ce3+/Ce4+ and Co2+ redox centers, abundant oxygen vacancies, and stable M–O–N covalency significantly enhances charge transfer, hydrophilicity, and structural stability. Consequently, the catalyst exhibits lower overpotentials of 289 mV (OER) and 64.

pmc-13575775.title: Trends in Use of Antiseizure Medicines in Women With Epilepsy in Pregnancy During 2018–2023 in an Irish Maternity Hospital: A Cohort Study
pmc-13575775.creator: Joan E Devin, Fergal O’Shaughnessy, Brian J Cleary, Jennifer C Donnelly, Nicola Maher, Karuna Sharma
pmc-13575775.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to describe and explore the trends of antiseizure medicine (ASM) use in women with epilepsy (WWE) in pregnancy over a 6‐year period.MethodsThis observational cohort study used routinely collected electronic health record (EHR) data from a large maternity hospital in Dublin, Ireland, with > 9000 births annually. WWE attending during pregnancy between 2018 and 2023 were included.

pmc-13673273.title: Delayed diagnosis leading to severe complications in primary hyperparathyroidism caused by atypical parathyroid tumor
pmc-13673273.creator: Francesca Lacchè, Alessandro Ciarloni, Monia Bordoni, Gianmaria Salvio, Giancarlo Balercia, Gilberta Giacchetti
pmc-13673273.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Severe skeletal complications at the onset of primary hyperparathyroidism are uncommon in contemporary Western clinical practice because routine serum calcium measurement usually allows early diagnosis. We describe a case of primary hyperparathyroidism in which delayed diagnosis, despite suggestive symptoms, led to an extremely severe presentation characterized by multiple fractures, osteolytic lesions, and prolonged postsurgical hungry bone syndrome requiring several months of intensive treatments and hospitalization. During hospitalization, the patient developed potentially life-threatening infectious and thrombotic complications.

pmc-13682844.title: CentroFinder: a multi-feature framework for de novo prediction of fungal regional centromeres
pmc-13682844.creator: Sahar Salimi, Sharon Colson, Michael Renfro, Li-Jun Ma, Mostafa Rahnama
pmc-13682844.description: MotivationCentromeres are essential chromosomal loci, yet their computational identification remains challenging due to rapid sequence evolution, high repeat content, and the absence of conserved defining motifs. This challenge is particularly pronounced in fungi, where centromere architectures vary widely in size, sequence composition, and chromatin organization, limiting the effectiveness of single-feature or motif-based prediction approaches.
